proof_body:
by
  intro K _ f h2 h3
  rw [Polynomial.irreducible_iff_roots_eq_zero_of_degree_le_three h2 h3, Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at h2
  simp only [Polynomial.mem_roots hf, Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (f : Polynomial K), 2 ≤ f.natDegree → f.natDegree ≤ 3 → (Irreducible f ↔ ∀ a : K, f.eval a ≠ 0)
